messages:
riley: noticing increased mTLS failures across eu-west and ap-southeast after last night's RBAC cleanup. proxies failing to unwrap session tickets and client certs intermittently. sample log from eu-west proxy:
2026-03-23T01:12:09Z proxy-eu-11 cert_wrap_lookup: found wrapped_ticket s3://session-keys/eu/wrapped-20260323
2026-03-23T01:12:09Z proxy-eu-11 kms_unwrap: AccessDenied principal=arn:aws:iam::111222333444:role/key-handler key=alias/sessions-eu region=eu-west-1
2026-03-23T01:12:09Z proxy-eu-11 tls_resume_fail: ERR_SSL_SESSION_TICKET_INVALID

hema: which PR touched KMS scopes? I saw a housekeeping change that removed kms:Encrypt/Decrypt from several service roles in PR 5012. Could be we removed a multi-region alias mapping.

deploy-bot: Audit: CloudTrail shows 214 KMS:DecryptDenied events and 7 KMS:EncryptDenied events for principals tagged role:key-* between 01:05 and 01:20 across eu-west-1 and ap-southeast-1. Merged PR: #5012 (rbac/remove-unused-keys).

riley: immediate mitigation: attach scoped decrypt allow for alias/sessions-eu and alias/sessions-apac to the key-handler and cert-fetcher roles for 45m and pause any cert/session-key rotations. Also schedule proxy config reload waves.

ops-oncall: applied temp allow at 01:22 and triggered a canary reload in eu-west. verification: KMS:Decrypt success observed at 01:23:02 for role:key-handler. Resume success jumped from 62% -> 95% on canary.

hema: root cause: RBAC cleanup removed decrypt rights for roles that consume wrapped session keys across regions. Also found a mismatch: the RBAC change referenced alias/sessions (no region suffix) while runtime expects region-specific aliases. Key alias naming drift caused the scoping change to miss live consumers.

riley: follow-ups for postmortem: 1) create an owned inventory of KMS aliases mapped to consumers (rotators, distributors, proxies) and enforce a CI check that flags RBAC PRs touching aliases used by any runtime consumer; 2) add an alert: any KMS:DecryptDenied > 0 for roles with tag cert-consumer in 3m -> page eng-security + oncall; 3) make unwrap path tolerant: on KMS deny, fall back to fresh TLS handshake rather than dropping connection; 4) add short local in-memory cache for unwrapped session keys with conservative TTL (30s) after decrypt success to survive brief KMS flaps (security review required).

ciso-bot: Compliance note: attach PR approval and test evidence for RBAC changes to incident ticket. Update change control checklist to require key-consumer inventory stamp.

deploy-bot: Suggested CloudTrail query to collect events for timeline:
eventName = "Decrypt" OR eventName = "Encrypt" | where eventSource == "kms.amazonaws.com" and recipientAccountId == "111222333444" | where eventTime between ("2026-03-23T01:00:00Z","2026-03-23T02:00:00Z")

hema: assigning owners: @riley implement temp-policy rollback + PR to correct alias naming; @ops-oncall add alert + dashboard (session_resume_rate by region); @hema produce postmortem draft with CT snippets and proposed CI gating.

riley: thanks, will run the post-deploy validation script to detect any remaining alias mismatches before we re-run rotations. closing for now once postmortem is published. :thumbsup:
